config.notes: Remote Supabase MCP server. No API key is required: on first connection your client opens a browser to authorize access to your Supabase account via OAuth. Provides tools to manage Supabase projects, run SQL, and inspect database schemas.

installConfigs.instructions: No API key is required: on first connection Theia opens a browser to authorize access to your Supabase account via OAuth, then stores the resulting token automatically.
